activations.token_positions: one token per sentence: boundary_token_idx, the last token before the sentence; no sentence-span or all-token states

fork_window_selection.code: research/redesign/phase2_select.py in the parent repo (output research/redesign/phase2_forks.json, copied to configs/phase2_forks.json)
fork_window_selection.rule: random, not importance-driven: rng=default_rng(int(sha256('20260914:phase2_selection')[:8],16)); permute the 16 non-test MVP problems, draw a trace kind per problem; window = 20 contiguous forks [s,s+19] with s+18 < min(n-1, convergence_idx(K=5), final_answer_idx) and fork s+19 existing; s drawn uniformly from admissible starts; first 10 admissible trajectories kept
